subject: English
passage: Anthropologists have discovered a jade burial mask in Guatemala that may represent the earliest example of royal portraiture in Mesoamerica. Radiocarbon testing at the excavation site revealed that the mask was likely created between 400 and 600 CE. Art historian Maya Patterson believes the mask will be valuable in understanding more about the development of Maya artistic traditions during the Classic period.
prompt: Which choice best states the main topic of the text?

choices.A: A jade burial mask found in Guatemala
choices.C: A new technique for testing ancient materials
choices.D: The academic background of Maya Patterson

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it most accurately states the main topic of the text. The text begins by stating that anthropologists in Guatemala have discovered what may be the earliest known jade burial mask with royal portraiture in Mesoamerica. According to the text, the object was created between 400 and 600 CE. The text then mentions a researcher who comments on the mask's significance to the study of Maya artistic traditions. Thus, the main focus throughout the text is a jade burial mask found in Guatemala.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because the text mentions the Classic period only to indicate the era when the mask was created and when Maya artistic traditions were developing; there's no discussion of conflicts during this era.
